name: The Normal Elevator
desc:
In this game, you ride an absolutely normal elevator. Yep, that's it 

There are 31 floors in the game currently. 
VIP SERVER OWNERS: If you own a VIP server, you are given an elevator controller which allows you to choose which floors you want next for the server. 

Developers:
Eric (@NowDoTheHarlemShake)
John (@Dapale)

[Won BLOXY For Best Art Direction in 2015]
